title.value: Deployment of digital technologies in African cities: emerging issues and policy recommendations for local governments
title.justification: The title is directly mentioned in the research article, indicating the focus of the paper.
title.quote: Deployment of digital technologies in African cities: emerging issues and policy recommendations for local governments

analysis.description: This paper discusses the deployment of digital technologies in African cities, highlighting issues of digital inclusion, digital rights, and inequalities, and provides policy recommendations for inclusive governance and infrastructure development.

type.justification: The paper discusses findings from a workshop which explored real-world issues of technology deployment in African cities and provides actionable policy recommendations.
type.quote: As part of the African Cities Lab Summit 2023, we conducted a workshop with 20 multidisciplinary participants to explore issues related to the deployment of digital technologies in African cities.

name.justification: The paper focuses on digital technologies and their impact on urban governance and policy in African cities.
name.quote: This research is a policy paper that addresses these issues and provides policy recommendations for local governments.

name.justification: The paper evaluates the impact of digital technologies on urban dynamics and governance.
name.quote: An increasing number of revolutionary technologies have emerged and disrupted the urban dynamics in African cities.

name.justification: The paper addresses digital inclusion as a major concern in the deployment of digital technologies.
name.quote: ...encompassing broader concerns such as digital inclusion, digital rights, and the exacerbation of spatial and social inequalities.

name.justification: The context of smart cities is considered relevant given the focus on digital infrastructure and services in urban areas.
name.quote: Focusing on transparency, equity, and collaboration with communities, local governments play a vital role in fostering inclusive digital transformation, essential for equitable and rights-centric smart cities in Africa.
